node.title: Re^3: Licensing clarification: Requiring a BSD licensed dist in a Perl licensed dist
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: If I had to guess, it looks like [https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_SSD1306|this] could be the original code. The [https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_SSD1306/blob/master/license.txt|license] is the 3-clause BSD license, without the advertising clause, so AFAICT it should be GPL compatible. But you might also want to try and get confirmation from [https://github.com/iliapenev|iliapenev] about what the original code was (maybe open an issue).
